name: Catan Tactics
tagline: Four AI agents with personalities play Catan, negotiating and betraying, trained by self-play.

awards: Neelbauer Agentic Revolution Award (NARA) - Alumni Prize

problem: The builder wanted agents that strategise and negotiate.
solution: Each agent combines a self-play value network, tool-calling and a local LLM for negotiation in a full Catan game.
demo_moment: Team-described: watch agents trade and betray.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Neelbauer Agentic Revolution Award (NARA) - Alumni Prize” among 223 submissions.

lessons: A familiar board game is a clear arena for agent behaviour.
